items.title: Switching to Argon2id for password hashing
items.subtitle: Argon2id replaces Bcrypt with improved resistance to GPU-based password attacks
items.narrative: The authentication system is upgrading its password hashing algorithm from Bcrypt to Argon2id. Argon2id is significantly more resistant to GPU-based attacks because it requires substantial memory and time to compute each hash, making distributed cracking attempts prohibitively expensive even with specialized hardware. This decision strengthens defenses against modern password-cracking techniques and represents a strategic security hardening aligned with ongoing authentication improvements.
